sections.title: Open periods
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due_on

sections.title: Unfinished actions
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_on from actions where result is null order by due_on

sections.title: Source income
sections.sql: select * from v_income order by period,reseller,territory

sections.title: Unmatched recordings
sections.sql: select * from v_unmatched order by period,reported_isrc

sections.title: Provisional until the period is reviewed
sections.sql: select period,contract,partner,track,currency,earned_amount,opening_amount,cost_amount,recouped_amount,closing_amount,available_amount from v_recoupment order by period,contract
